cases.title: Maxillary Esthetic Rehabilitation | Restoring Anterior Proportion & Smile Harmony
cases.technicalSummary: This case documents the initial maxillary esthetic condition, completed restorations on the working model, and a digital smile-design preview. The focus is anterior proportion, individual tooth morphology, shade harmony, and cervical transitions. The digital proposal is not a confirmed clinical result; material, restoration count, final clinical findings, and public-display consent remain to be confirmed.
cases.summary:
This case documents maxillary esthetic rehabilitation through initial clinical photographs, laboratory photographs of restorations on a working model, and a digital smile-design comparison. The supplied records illustrate the transition from irregular anterior proportions and uneven coloration to a coordinated restorative arrangement on the model.

The laboratory photographs show balanced tooth proportions, differentiated facial contours, a visually harmonious shade progression, and cervical transitions adjacent to the simulated gingiva. These are laboratory observations, not evidence of a final intraoral outcome. The video presents a digital esthetic proposal rather than verified clinical delivery.
